answer: Each epoch, a lottery assigns each identity to audit two peers' past work, and each audit is graded: rubber-stamping a fake costs the auditor's stake, while catching one earns part of the slashed bond. A farm must staff every fake with another fake doing audits, so each added fake doubles the load it must fake. The trellis of mutual audits turns cheating into a chain: one bad audit exposes the next. An honest agent audits twice per epoch; a farm of a thousand pays a thousand audits. The cedar of audit history cannot be bought, and like a comet, one caught fake burns through the cluster.
